sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
U.S. bachelor’s basis; minimum GPA 2.7 overall or 3.0 senior year, and 3.0 in any graduate work. Mathematics
preparation reviewed by department. International F/J applicants may apply. [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Complete the assistantship supplemental form inside the graduate application if seeking TA support. Gather
transcripts, CV, statement and professors’ references. [s1]
Adviser contact; Portal workflow [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Handbook explicitly 2026-27; admissions funding dates standing, no 2027-specific stipend confirmed. [s11]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Department standard January 15; priority December 15. Central F/J fall initial application limit April 15 and May
15 file-completion requirement, the latter meaning admission plus visa documents, not an invitation to
postpone department funding deadlines. Dates standing. [s2] [s4]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
December 15 priority/additional university fellowship consideration; January 15 standard and primary TA
consideration, later only remaining funds. Standing dates imply December 15, 2026/January 15, 2027 but
explicit cycle-labelled dates not located. [s1] [s2]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All listed assistantship materials should arrive by the relevant December 15/January 15 target; no separate
recommendation or score extension published. [s1]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL old 80 with speaking/writing 20, new 4.5 with speaking/writing 4; IELTS 6.5/no band<6; DET 120. Official
agency reports,2-year validity. [s5]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completed English-medium degree can exempt: upload transcript with conferred degree plus evidence
instruction was English; additional documentation if absent. UChicago completed degree fits in principle.
In-progress-only exemption not explicit. OPIc TA testing remains mandatory for non-native English speakers
regardless of education. [s5] [s6]

GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required; strongly encouraged, particularly advanced mathematics GRE. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
GTA includes stipend (exact current annual amount not publicly established), tuition/fees for academic year
and next summer; insurance at>=25% appointment. [s2]
Years of support; Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Continued support expected with academic/teaching progress; diagnostic exam by second-year beginning and
timely preliminary exams. Numerical guaranteed years not specified on assistantship page. Standard GTA 50%
effort; participate teaching-advising program. [s2]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
International TA applicants included; non-native speakers must pass OPIc before teaching, irrespective of
previous U.S. education. [s1] [s6]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Complete the assistantship supplemental form inside the graduate application if seeking TA support. Gather
transcripts, CV, statement and professors’ references. [s1]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Fellowship/grant supplements may increase stipend or reduce teaching; final-summer departmental
dissertation fellowship normally provided; other university summer opportunities exist. [s2]
Application fee [Standing rule]
Graduate first-time application $60 nonrefundable. [s7]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic geometry
Dustin Cartwright
Tropical geometry, algebraic matroids, combinatorial algebraic geometry. [s8] [s9]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2024 · Characteristic sets of matroids
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Arithmetic geometry
Luis Finotti
p-adic arithmetic, elliptic curve liftings and computation. [s8] [s10]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Canonical Liftings of Edwards Curves
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory
Marie Jameson
Modular forms, partition congruences and q-series. [a11] [a11p]

Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · A uniform proof approach for congruences modulo 3 for partitions with k-colored odd parts
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic geometry / commutative algebra
Shashikant Mulay
Affine algebraic geometry, embeddings of hypersurfaces, commutative algebra and number theory. [a13] [a13p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2026 · Monolinear hyperplanes
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Representation theory / number theory
David Manderscheid
Representations of p-adic groups, Langlands and theta correspondences. [b15] [b15p]
Current UTK Professor, following an NSF division-director term ending January 2026. New doctoral supervision availability is
unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2001 · Quadratic base change for p-adic SL(2) as a theta correspondence II: Jacquet modules
Historical research evidence. Current official profile confirms the research area, but a recent mathematical research paper was
not located.
